en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a railway station with a steam locomotive pulling freight cars on the right. People stand on the platform in front of a large, ornate station building with steep tiled roofs and multiple gables. To the left, a tall church tower with a spire rises behind trees. The words "Mariestad" and "Järnvägsstationen" are printed at the top of the image, indicating the town and that this is the railway station.
